import trimesh, numpy as np
base = trimesh.load('exports/model.base.87e59dfb.stl')
lid = trimesh.load('exports/model.lid.6029fe16.stl')
print("base bounds", base.bounds, "lid bounds", lid.bounds)
ax_pt = np.array([0.,56.,29.8]); ax = np.array([-1.,0.,0.])
for deg in [95,100,105,110]:
    m = trimesh.transformations.rotation_matrix(np.radians(deg), ax, ax_pt)
    l = lid.copy(); l.apply_transform(m)
    inter = base.intersection(l)
    v = inter.volume if hasattr(inter,'volume') else 0
    try: b = inter.bounds
    except: b = None
    print(deg, "inter_vol=%.3f"%v, "bounds=", None if b is None else b.tolist())
